# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 8 (Bi-Vb Np8)
**ID:** Bi-Vb Np8
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)

**Title (English, from literature):** Exchanging designated collective property

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Gaṇikacetāpana Sikkhāpada* (Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 8) is a disciplinary rule from the Vinaya Piṭaka governing the conduct of Buddhist nuns (*bhikkhunīs*) [SuttaCentral]. The rule establishes that a nun who exchanges away a collective requisite that has been designated for a specific purpose commits an offense of expiation involving forfeiture, requiring her to relinquish the item and confess the transgression [SuttaCentral]. The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali under the title *Exchanging designated collective property* [SuttaCentral].
Full parallels within the Pali tradition are found in the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Bi-Pm Np 8) and the Bhikkhunī Parivāra (Np 8) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral also notes related parallels regarding the exchange of designated communal property (*Saṁghikacetapana*) across several other Vinaya lineages, including the Dharmaguptaka, Mahīśāsaka, Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahāsāṅghika, and Lokottaravādin recensions, as well as Bi-Vb Np 6 within the Pali corpus [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus reports substantial Pali-internal text reuse with neighbouring sections of the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (particularly Bi-Vb Np 7, Np 10, Np 9, and Np 6) as well as the Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus additionally aligns passages of this rule with the Sanskrit *Bhikṣuṇīvinaya* and Tibetan Vinaya commentaries, including the *Pratimokṣasūtraṭīkā Vinayasamuccaya* (D4106) and the *Vinayasūtravṛtti* (D4122) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
